config:lab_creation.cfg.changes: Add optional CLOUD_DNS_IMAGE: the image the cloud DNS VM boots from.

lab.changes: Add optional kclusters.clu_token: the join token set on the first rke2/k3s server.
open_ports and aws_open_ports (common and per-node) are declared as the lists every backend reads them as, instead of strings
pre_commands and post_commands: shell commands a VM runs itself, before any other work and after all of it
lab_description in common: one line saying what a lab is for, shown where labs are listed
clu_type kubeadm (upstream Kubernetes built with kubeadm), with clu_cni and clu_pod_cidr for the network plugin it applies.
kclusters gains clu_ingress and clu_storage: the ingress controller and default storage class of a cluster, installed as add-ons when its distribution brings none
nodes.myip is optional: an address is allocated from the network the lab already describes when the definition gives none

ISO_URL and ISO_SHA256_URL declared again, hidden and deprecated: setup_lab.py still downloads them. A URL in SOURCE_IMAGE is downloaded the same way, once into ISO_LOC on each KVM host and checked against SOURCE_SHA256, which it requires.
